== Description ==
The '''Lawnmower''' was an [[Area 51]] [[Enemies|enemy]] that only appeared during the [[Area 51 Event]]. Though it was slower than the [[Alien (Area 51)|Alien]], it had much more health than anything that appeared before it, making it dangerous to the unprepared.

== Appearance ==
The '''Lawnmower''' was a bloated humanoid driving a green lawnmower. The humanoid itself had light green skin, a white bloated torso and khaki legs. It wore shades and had a sad drooling face. It was holding a [https://www.roblox.com/catalog/10472779/Bloxy-Cola Bloxy Cola] while sitting awkwardly on the lawnmower.

== Strategy ==
*Due to this enemy being relatively strong for its debut, you may need to buy more towers or upgrade your current ones to kill it.
**High DPS towers, such as the [[Minigunner]] or [[Crook Boss]], are very useful for this.
**Additionally, due to its slow speed, the [[Ranger|Outlaw]] can also be effective when dealing with this enemy.
*The [[Freezer]] and [[Pyromancer]] can be used to slow this [[Enemies|enemy]] down.

== Trivia ==
*This enemy was initially called ''Boomer'' even though it did not explode when it was killed.
**It was named as such because the humanoid on the '''Lawnmower'''  uses the same model as the [[Boomer 1]] and [[Boomer 2]], possibly as an oversight.
*Unlike the other [[Area 51]] enemies, the '''Lawnmower''' appeared to bear no reference to Area 51 itself.
